stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: 21 pts for Wendy Mangelsdorf, top of the table and the sausage sizzle already fired up for the presentation.

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 73 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: The Home Team
stories.detail: Wendy and Neil are flying the Mangelsdorf flag today, and Sunday lunch just got competitive.

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 2 off the pace

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Up 20 spots since early on - flying up the board

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Robert Oliver of Cowra GC is welcome back anytime, preferably off a few less shots.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Single-figure golf on show - 7 marker sitting 9th

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 3 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Perfectly Mediocre
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers straight - one point at a time, every time

stories.title: The Phoenix
stories.detail: Wipe then 3-pointer on holes 8 & 9 - drama then redemption

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: One-Point Parade
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 7, 8 & 9 - sticking to the 1-point script

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 9 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 6 & 7 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 4 & 5

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 4, 5 & 6 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 6 & 7 - club still in the bag

stories.title: Technical Difficulties
stories.detail: 3 wipes on holes 2, 3 & 4 - please stand by

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Finals are won late and Sandra Glastonbury drifted 8th to 17th in exactly that stretch.

stories.title: Footy Form Guide
stories.detail: 10 pts from Dennis Lawson when 1.1 is the norm, the kick-to-kick was off all afternoon.
